mapper.update: update pda_tables u1 set (u1.ROW_NUM,u1.LAST_ANALYZED,u1.TABLE_INDEX) = (select distinct a.num_rows,to_char(a.LAST_ANALYZED,'yyyy-MM-dd hh24:mi:ss'),b.tab_index from (select table_name,num_rows,LAST_ANALYZED from user_tables) a left join (select TABLE_NAME,listagg('名称:'||INDEX_NAME||',唯一性:'||uniqueness, ';') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY TABLE_NAME) as tab_index from user_indexes group by TABLE_NAME) b on (a.TABLE_NAME = b.TABLE_NAME) where u1.name = a.TABLE_NAME)
mapper.select: select distinct a.TABLE_NAME as name,'' as table_name,a.num_rows,a.LAST_ANALYZED,b.tab_index,'',0 as CLICK_NUM,1 as status from (select table_name,'',num_rows,LAST_ANALYZED from user_tables where TABLE_NAME not in (select name from PDA_TABLES)) a left join (select TABLE_NAME,listagg('名称:'||INDEX_NAME||',唯一性:'||uniqueness, ';') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY TABLE_NAME) as tab_index from user_indexes group by TABLE_NAME) b on (a.TABLE_NAME = b.TABLE_NAME)
